QF.id: SIA Social Impact Assessment and Assessors_22

question.text: In a Social Impact Assessment engagement, the 'Three-Party Relationship' under Section 5.9.1 involves:

answer.text: SIA, SEBI, and the auditee's statutory auditor
SIA, Responsible Party, and Intended Users

explanation.text: The Logic: Section 5.9.1 is explicit: 'Social impact assessment engagements involve three separate parties: a social impact assessor, a responsible party and intended users.' The responsible party and intended users may or may not be in the same entity; the engaging party can be a donor distinct from the SE. The Trap: Option A confuses the three-party model with a statutory-audit structure. Option C lists the regulatory ecosystem, not engagement parties. Option B is incomplete and mis-named. Cross-Exam Context: The three-party assurance structure is not tested in X-A / X-B / XV / V-A. XXIII aligns with international assurance standards (ISAE 3000) via ICAI SIAB guidance. Assessor's Pro-Tip: Write the three-party triangle into the opening paragraph of your engagement letter — naming the SE (responsible party), the funder or SE board (engaging party), and the intended users (donors, regulators, SSE listing disclosure readers).
